```{r options-global, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
meta <- list()
meta$seed <- 1234
meta$brms_chains <- 6
meta$brms_iterations <- 4000
meta$brms_family <- gaussian()
meta$ci_inner <- .66
meta$ci_outer <- .95
meta$missing <- list()

set.seed(meta$seed)

library("data.table")
library("ggplot2")
library("magrittr")
library("dplyr")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  cache = TRUE,
  autodep = TRUE,
  dev = c("png", "pdf", "svg")
)

options(
  # multicore features
  Ncpus = parallel::detectCores() - 1L,
  mc.cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1L,
  brms.backend = "cmdstanr"
)
```
